what: Preparing Orin Nano microSD installation and Linux ARM64 arm dependencies
why: The board needs a fresh OS. Preparing official images and a compatible runtime before first boot reduces setup time and corrects the earlier USB/SSD assumptions.
details: Selected NVIDIA JetPack 6.2.1 SD image with documented APT update to 6.2.3; conditional 5.1.3 firmware-bridge image and Apple Silicon Etcher are downloading to the Mac external drive. Added NVIDIA firmware, hardware, KVM, upgrade and power references. Moved existing SciPy pin into base requirements; Python 3.12/Linux ARM64 resolution succeeds for 16 packages. A fresh macOS Python 3.12 environment passes all 140 offline arm tests and pickup-client --help. Downloads and Jetson execution are not yet verified. No media flashed, SSD formatted, firmware changed or robot commands sent.
